boy_000.text: I use the internet almost every day — look, my laptop!

boy_001.text: Wait... is the internet ALWAYS good? Or are there bad things too?

girl_002.text: Let's find out — together. Come on, explorer!

boy_003.text: Whoa — the whole internet is waiting for us!

girl_004.text: Yes! But remember our question — is it ALWAYS good? Let's keep our eyes open.

boy_005.text: So when I send a message, it travels all the way to a global server and back?!

girl_006.text: Exactly! Tap the glowing Data Packet to watch it travel forward and bring back the answer!

boy_007.text: Watch how fast it zooms from my laptop to the server and returns!

boy_008.text: Whoa! Look at all the things we can do on the internet!

girl_009.text: And we can CREATE and play too — not just watch. Tap every building to step inside and explore!

boy_010.text: We can learn and CREATE almost anything here. This is amazing!

girl_011.text: It really is. But… if the internet is this powerful, could some parts be risky too?

boy_012.text: Hmm. Let’s keep exploring and find out.

girl_013.text: Here come different internet habits. Some are great… some, not so good.

boy_014.text: Easy! Drag each one into GOOD CHOICE or NOT SO GOOD. Let’s sort them!

boy_015.text: That was easier than I thought! Good and not-so-good aren’t so hard to tell apart.

girl_016.text: Sometimes though… the SAME thing can be good OR bad. Like gaming — a little is fun, too much isn’t.

boy_017.text: Ohh. So it’s about balance. Let’s test that next!

girl_018.text: This is the Internet Balance Scale. Benefits on the left, risks on the right.

boy_019.text: So if I add too many risky habits… the scale tips! Let’s test our moderation.

boy_020.text: So the same activity can be good OR bad — it depends how much!

girl_021.text: Exactly. Too much of anything tips the balance. The trick is moderation.

boy_022.text: Sometimes after staring at a screen for hours, my eyes sting, get red, and I get a headache.

girl_023.text: Let us test our 3D Vision Simulator to see exactly what happens to eyes during long screen time and how to fix it!

girl_025.text: Welcome to the Privacy Locker! Some personal data must be locked in the Cyber Vault forever.

boy_026.text: While other things like hobbies and avatars are fun to share. Let us sort them and see what happens!

boy_027.text: Locked and safe! My passwords and address are guarded in the Cyber Vault forever.

girl_028.text: And my gamer avatar is ready for the world. Let us check out Scam Alley next!

boy_029.text: I just opened my messaging app on my laptop, and strange chat popups are appearing!

girl_030.text: Careful Aarav! Scammers use sneaky tricks. Let us inspect each message and reply wisely!

girl_033.text: Outstanding work! You stopped all three scam traps before they could do any harm.

boy_034.text: Now let us see what happens when strangers message us during online gaming!

girl_035.text: We just launched PixelQuest Arena in our digital lounge. An unknown player started messaging our avatar.

boy_036.text: Let us deploy our live in-game privacy tools to defend our identity and safety!

boy_037.text: All 3 stranger traps defeated! Personal identity, photo, and location stayed 100% safe!

girl_038.text: That uncomfortable feeling is the warning alarm. Block, report, and always tell trusted adults.

boy_039.text: Welcome to the Truth Forensic Lab! Four viral news headlines need investigation.

girl_040.text: Let us analyze the evidence, fill our Truth & Falsehood Meters, and determine our Forensic Level!

boy_041.text: Both meters are at 100%! We can spot fake viral stories and verify real science anytime.

girl_042.text: Now let us see the entire global journey of the internet across our panoramic city!

boy_043.text: LOOK AT THE ENTIRE PANORAMIC DIGITAL CITY! We can see our home, the city 5G tower, the ocean cable terminal, and our school!

girl_044.text: Let us interactively route a data packet across the entire global internet highway!

girl_045.text: The internet connects our whole world at the speed of light.

boy_046.text: And we have the superpowers to use it safely and creatively. Time to seal our rulebook!

girl_051.text: It is time to draft our 5 Golden Commandments of Digital Citizenship!

boy_052.text: Let us seal every rule onto our classroom golden charter!

boy_054.text: Our Golden Digital Rulebook is complete! Ready for the Final Challenge Arena!

girl_055.text: Let us test everything we learned!

girl_056.text: We did it! We explored the entire internet from undersea cables to cyber defense!

boy_057.text: One final moment to seal our Master Explorer badge — let’s finish strong!
